title: Harden configured path health probe
summary: Hardened read-only configured path health so path reachability, listing, capacity measurement, retry evidence, and stale-good capacity evidence are reported as distinct fields.
reason: Slow UNC capacity checks could be surfaced as generic low-space blockers even when the configured reserve was satisfied. Launch and autonomy gating need fail-closed path health without mislabeling unknown or timed-out capacity as measured low free space.
behavior_before: Configured path health exposed only coarse path/storage evidence. A slow UNC path could time out under a short gate and be confused with insufficient free space.
behavior_after: Configured path health keeps the v1 schema and adds health codes, bounded retry attempts, phase timings, capacity source/path/error, share-root fallback capacity, and evidence-only last successful capacity. Autonomy low-space blockers now require measured low storage evidence.
manual_validation: focused process-launch preflight tests - passed (2 tests)
live read-only autonomy_health_gate repro against C:\Scripts\MediaPipeline_config.psd1 - passed; overall_status=ready; UNC output free bytes 115867480227 vs 50 GB reserve
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due 11 unrelated generated files outside this packet
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet's source, UI, tests, and generated summary edits. That restores the prior 1-second/default-only path health behavior and removes the additive evidence fields.
notes:
Hardened configured path health with bounded UNC retry, capacity-source evidence, share-root fallback, and stale-good capacity evidence-only cache.
Real-media validation not required; change is read-only launch/evidence behavior with no media processing or file movement.
